hotels.title: Five-Star Sofitel Foshan Luxury in the Heart of Guangdong
hotels.description: Rising above Foshan’s Chancheng District, this grand French-inspired retreat forms part of the Louvre International Furniture Exhibition Centre and sits within easy reach of Zumiao Temple and Lingnan Tiandi’s heritage lanes. Palatial rooms feature marble bathrooms, plush Sofitel MyBed sleep systems and sweeping views across the city skyline. Spend afternoons drifting between the indoor pool, spa and well-equipped fitness centre, then dine on refined Cantonese cuisine at Le Chinois or elegant international fare at all-day dining venue Kwee Zeen. A short drive away, Qiandeng Lake offers waterfront promenades, evening light displays and polished dining precincts
